thread:
anya: Hey team — can we lock a 45m retro for the K8s autoscaler incident? Looking to schedule this week. Proposed: Thu 2pm PT or Fri 10am PT. Need attendees: eng-runtime, eng-infra, oncall, product. Prework: add one postmortem note to the doc, bring one action item you own. Agenda: timeline + impact (10), root causes (15), actions & owners (15), retro format check (5). Thoughts?

sam: Thu 2pm clashes with customer sync. Fri 10am works for me. +1 on prework. :thumbsup:

lee: Fri OK but can we make it 60m? There's quite a bit to go over.

maria: I can do 45m. If we go 60, please invite support and product PMs explicitly.

ishaan: I can facilitate this Fri if folks want. I'll put together a timeline slide and a brief RCA sketch.

retro-bot: Reminder — please add your 1-line impact + relevant links to the incident doc by EOD Wed.

anya: Cool — let's do Fri 10:00 PT, 45m. @ishaan willing to facilitate? I'll send the invite now and ask for RSVPs by EOD Wed.

ishaan: Happy to facilitate. I'll add a prework checklist in the doc:
- add 1-line impact
- paste PRs/log snippets
- suggest 1 action and an owner

sam: + add 'verification plan' to the actions list so owners include how we'll validate the fix.

lee: Can we also add a "what went well" bullet? Keeps the tone balanced.

maria: Please record the session for folks on call. Also can we keep notes concise?

anya: Yes to recording. I'll include the doc and recording flag in the invite. If anyone can't make it, please drop your notes in the doc beforehand.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created — Retro: K8s autoscaler incident — Fri 10:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123

anya: Thanks — I'll send a quick follow-up DM to @support-lead to confirm attendance.

sam: One small ask: can we block time after the retro for action owners? 15m.

ishaan: Good call. I'll put a 15m follow-up slot in the calendar and pre-assign a placeholder owner slot.

anya: Done. Agenda in doc updated. See you all Friday.

maria: Thanks, team.
